title: California egg shortage drives prices to nearly $9 per dozen - San Francisco Chronicle
snippet: California egg prices jump 70% due to bird flu outbreaks A sign posted in store coolers at Whole Foods on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco reads, “For now, we’re limiting purchases to 3 cartons per customer.” Egg prices have spiked 70% amid a nationwide dairy shortage spurred by the outbreak of H5N1 avian flu, commonly known as bird flu.
